name: DEV Community (Forem) API
summary: Keyless JSON API for articles, tags, podcast episodes and videos on DEV, a developer blogging community built on Forem.
description: The Forem API v1 serves public reads without a key: article lists filtered by tag, user or time window, single articles with full markdown, tag lists, podcast episodes and videos. A free API key (api-key header) unlocks authoring and analytics endpoints. The OpenAPI document also lists many admin and write operations that do not apply to anonymous use.

auth.notes: Public reads work without a key; per the OpenAPI description a key (api-key header) is needed for write and account endpoints.

required_headers.name: User-Agent
required_headers.notes: A request with an empty User-Agent returned 403.

rate_limit.summary: No numbers documented in the spec. A burst of about nine requests in a few seconds produced 429 'Retry later' on later calls, so pace requests.

license.name: Not stated; articles belong to their authors

coverage.temporal: Articles published on dev.to; new ones appear within minutes

agent_notes: top=N (days since publication) returns the most popular articles of the last N days and combines with tag. tag_list is an array in list responses and tags is a comma string. Use /articles/{id} for the full serialized article including its body; list responses carry only metadata. Forem is open source, so other Forem instances expose the same API under their own host.
caveats: /comments and /organizations/devteam returned 429 'Retry later' after a burst of requests, so those were not confirmed.
/users/ben returned 404; the OpenAPI document defines /users/{id} (an id, not a username) and /users/me.
Copyright of articles stays with the authors; check before republishing.

verification.notes: Exact example executed without a key; articles/latest, articles/{id}, tags, podcast_episodes and videos also returned 200.
